drk.text: Sacumon is a sorceress ordered by Lord Peemel to incite war between the elves and the minotaurs, and she works with the Niroso and their coal golems.

The Niroso, manipulated by Sacumon, burn elven and minotaur homes so that each side blames the other, and she gives Yunnie the cursed Living Armor, using blood magic to make him forget her and be unable to speak of her.
Yunnie and Coernn best Sacumon in the caves of the Niroso, and she dies, fading into a dried husk, though a coal golem burns Coernn to death.
